Context & provenance

About this edition.

Part Two of the hadith of Abu 'Ubayda Muja'a b. al-Zubayr al-'Ataki al-Basri (d. 146 AH), published in the series Hadith Parts and Books (no. 20) by Dar al-Basha'ir al-Islamiyya. Narrations are numbered in the edition.

The edition

  • TextḤadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr
  • Attributed toMujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr (d. 146 AH)
  • EditionDar al-Basha'ir al-Islamiyya [within the Series of Hadith Parts and Books (20)], First, 1423 AH – 2003 CE
  • Kind of workPart (juz') of a scholar’s hadith
  • English translationThe English is the supplied translation of each page. The source file names no translator.
  • Extent107 narrations

How the text is presented

Catalog header

The first page record repeats the Shamela catalog header (title, author, editor, publisher). It is not reproduced as an entry.

Translator note

Honorifics: صلى الله عليه وسلم → ﷺ; عز وجل → ﷻ; تبارك وتعالى → ﵎; رضي الله عنه/عنها/عنهم → ﵁/﵂/﵃. A standalone تعالى has no dedicated symbol and is rendered “Most High”. The closing doxologies (records 1314741 and 1314761) are rendered with ﷺ in place of the written-out blessing and peace formula. “Allah” is rendered “God” except inside 'Abd Allah and 'Ubayd Allah. Isnad phrases such as وبه / وبإسناده are rendered “by the same chain of transmission” / “by his chain of transmission”.

Translator note

Square brackets [ ] and ⦗p. N⦘ page markers are carried over exactly as they stand in the Arabic (editorial restorations and print-page breaks). Short parenthetical glosses of technical terms (e.g. jadha'a, mujaththama, mayathir) were added only where a bare transliteration would be unintelligible.

Arabic text

The Arabic is shown exactly as supplied. Where an entry opens with its printed number, the number appears in the label instead of the text. Square brackets and page markers are carried over from the source.

Isnad and matn

Where the Arabic gives a chain before the words, the chain and the words are shown apart and the English is divided at the same point. Entries with no chain say so. The division follows a fixed rule and does not alter the text.

Dating

Century is based on the compiler/associated authority's death year, not a verified date of composition. The date shown is the death year of Muja'a b. al-Zubayr, 146 AH.

Structure

A numbered part (juz') of reports, each with its own chain. The series and title pages stand before the narrations and are not counted among them.

Transmitters

The source supplies no separate transmitter data. Where a report states its own chain, the transmission path lists the names exactly as the isnad words them, read from the text between its transmission terms; English names are shown only where they line up one for one with the Arabic. No transmitter is identified beyond the wording of the source.

The opening and closing material

Title pages, the chain through which the copy was transmitted, and notes that frame the text are kept here. They are not counted among the narrations.

01   Series information and title page Read full text ↓

Series of Hadith Parts and Books (22, 21, 20). A compilation containing three hadith treatises: [From the Hadith of Abu 'Ubayda Muja'a b. al-Zubayr al-'Ataki al-Basri]; from the hadith of Muhammad b. 'Uthman b. Karama and the hadith of Tahir b. Khalid b. Nizar al-Ayli, transmitted by Muhammad b. Makhlad al-'Attar from the two of them; and the additions in the Kitab al-Jud wa-l-Sakha' of the Imam and Hafiz Abu al-Qasim Sulayman b. Ahmad al-Tabarani. Edited and verified by Dr. 'Amir Hasan Sabri. Dar al-Basha'ir al-Islamiyya. First edition, 1423 AH – 2003 CE.

سلسلة الأجزاء والكتب الحديثية (22، 21، 20) مجموع فيه ثلاث رسائل حديثية -[من حديث أبي عبيدة مجاعة بن الزبير العتكي البصري]- من حديث محمد بن عثمان بن كرامة وحديث طاهر بن خالد بن نزار الأيلي رواية محمد بن مخلد العطار عنهما الزيادات في كتاب الجود والسخاء للإمام الحافظ أبي القاسم سليمان بن أحمد الطبراني تحقيق الدكتور عامر حسن صبري دار البشائر الإسلامية الطبعة الأولى 1423هـ - 2003م

02   Series information and title page · p. 9 Read full text ↓

Series of Hadith Parts and Books (20). From the hadith of Abu 'Ubayda Muja'a b. al-Zubayr al-'Ataki, in three sections: Section One: the transmission of Ibn Qani' from al-Sari b. Sahl, from 'Abd Allah b. Rushayd, from Muja'a. Section Two: from the transmission of Abu al-Husayn 'Abd al-Samad b. 'Ali al-Tasi al-Baghdadi, from al-Sari, with it. Section Three: the copy of al-Sari, from Muja'a, of what does not occur in the first two sections.

سلسلة الأجزاء والكتب الحديثية (20) من حديث أبي عبيدة مجاعة بن الزبير العتكي وفيه ثلاثة أقسام: القسم الأول: رواية ابن قانع عن السري بن سهل عن عبد الله بن رشيد عن مجاعة. القسم الثاني: من رواية أبي الحسين عبد الصمد بن علي الطسي البغدادي، عن السري به. القسم الثالث: نسخة السري، عن مجاعة مما لم يرد في القسمين الأولين.

03   Series information and title page · p. 37 Read full text ↓

Part Two of the hadith of Abu 'Ubayda Muja'a b. al-Zubayr al-'Ataki, in the transmission of the judge Abu al-Husayn 'Abd al-Baqi b. Qani' from al-Sari b. Sahl, [from 'Abd Allah] b. Rushayd, from him [Muja'a]. It also contains hadith of Ibn Qani' from his shaykhs. Transmission of Abu al-Hasan Ahmad b. 'Ali b. al-Hasan al-Bada from Ibn Qani'; transmission of Abu al-Hasan Muhammad b. Ahmad b. Muhammad b. al-Jabban from Ibn al-Bada; transmission of the righteous and trustworthy shaykh Abu al-Ma'ali Muhammad b. Muhammad b. Muhammad from his aforementioned grandfather; transmission of the righteous shaykh Abu 'Abd Allah Muhammad b. 'Abd Allah b. al-Husayn al-Harawi, then [al-Ishkidhbani], from him ﵃ (all of them). Audition of Isma'il b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Abd al-Muhsin al-Ansari al-Maliki, known as Ibn al-Anmati—may God, the Generous, benefit him by it. Amen.

الجزء الثاني من حديث أبي عبيدة مجاعة بن الزبير العتكي رواية القاضي أبي الحسين عبد الباقي بن قانع عن السري بن سهل [عن عبد الله بن] رشيد عنه وفيه من حديث ابن قانع عن شيوخه رواية أبي الحسن أحمد بن علي بن الحسن البادا عن ابن قانع رواية أبي الحسن محمد بن أحمد بن محمد بن الجبان عن ابن البادا رواية الشيخ الصالح الثقة أبي المعالي محمد بن محمد بن محمد عن جده المذكور رواية الشيخ الصالح أبي عبد الله محمد بن عبد الله بن الحسين الهروي ثم [الإشكيذباني] عنه رضي الله عنهم أجمعين سماع لإسماعيل بن عبد الله بن عبد المحسن الأنصاري المالكي عرف بابن الأنماطي نفعه الله الكريم به آمين.

04   Series information and title page · p. 39 Read full text ↓

In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. O God, make it easy and make it beneficial. My Lord, increase me in knowledge. The shaykh, jurist, righteous ascetic Abu 'Abd Allah Muhammad b. 'Abd Allah b. al-Husayn al-Ishkidhbani al-Hanbali—may God grant him success—informed us, by recitation to him in God’s Sacred Precinct, facing the Black Stone, on the thirteenth of [ .. .. .. ] of the year five hundred and ninety. He said: The righteous shaykh Abu al-Ma'ali Muhammad b. Muhammad b. al-Jabban, known as Ibn al-Lahhas, informed us, by my recitation to him on the twenty-eighth of Dhu al-Qa'da of the year five hundred and fifty-six, in his house in al-Harim al-Tahiri. He said: My grandfather Muhammad b. Ahmad informed us. He said: Abu al-Hasan Ahmad b. 'Ali b. al-Hasan al-Bada informed us, by recitation to him in his house in the year four hundred and fifteen: The judge Abu al-Husayn 'Abd al-Baqi b. Qani' narrated to us: Abu Sahl al-Sari b. Sahl al-Jundisaburi narrated to us: 'Abd Allah b. Rushayd narrated to us: Abu 'Ubayda Muja'a b. al-Zubayr al-'Ataki narrated to us:

بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم اللهم يسر وانفع رب زدني علما أخبرنا الشيخ الفقيه الصالح الزاهد أبو عبد الله محمد بن عبد الله بن الحسين الإشكيذباني الحنبلي وفقه الله قراءة عليه بحرم الله تجاه الحجر الأسود في ثالث عشر [ .. .. .. ] سنة تسعين وخمسمائة قال أخبرنا الشيخ الصالح أبو المعالي محمد بن محمد بن الجبان المعروف بابن اللحاس بقراءتي عليه ثامن والعشرين من ذي القعدة سنة ست وخمسين وخمسمائة في منزله بالحريم الطاهري قال أخبرنا جدي محمد بن أحمد قال أخبرنا أبو الحسن أحمد بن علي بن الحسن البادا قراءة عليه في منزله في سنة خمس عشرة وأربعمائة حدثنا أبو الحسين عبد الباقي بن قانع القاضي حدثنا أبو سهل السري بن سهل الجنديسابوري حدثنا عبد الله بن رشيد حدثنا أبو عبيدة مجاعة بن الزبير العتكي:
